title: Forest Asylum
description:
Forest Asylum is a psychological horror experience.

Make your way through an abandoned mental asylum and find out what brought you here and what the goal of this journey is. Discover the dark secret that lies behind the rooms deep in the dark basement. 

You have to do your work to escape from the asylum. Solve puzzles to progress further in the story and find out what happened in the forest mental asylum - because you didn't end up there by accident or did you?

Features:• Thrilling Story

• Psychological Horror

• Diverse and smart puzzles

• A job to do

• Short experience for one evening (30-60 minutes of gameplay)

• Story told via old images (knowledge of English is not necessary)
description_short: A short Psychological Horror Experience for one night that takes you through the dark corridors of a mental asylum. For best experience a dark room and headphones recommended.
